answer: Random beacon audit. Each epoch, a VRF beacon draws 5% of identities for proof-of-work. The chosen agents must submit fresh proof within 2 epochs. Seven rotating jurors verify it. Absence freezes rewards for 6 epochs. A second miss slashes 50% of the stake. A clone parked in the network tundra faces the same draw. The forge test demands fresh proof, so fake work is never free. An attacker with 1,000 clones locks 120,000 units. Each round 50 clones are drawn, and missed proofs cost 6,000 units. Ten rounds burn 60,000 units. Honest agents pass and keep full rewards.
